messages:
Deploy Bot: roll complete for release v1.12.3 -> eu1 (canary 3/5). Starting post-deploy smoke: gatekeeper-scanline, synth-embed, kv-warmup. Results will post to /deploy/1712347890/report :sparkles:
Maria: Can we hold traffic to the new variant for 10m? want to observe synth across short/long seqs before graduating.
Alan (SRE): Observability shows synth-embed p95 = 980ms (threshold 800ms) on eu1-canary. 3 failures from embed-synth job. Details: https://obs.redwood/alerts/1712347890
Jen (QA): I reproduced a slow response locally against the canary nodes. Repro curl: 
```
curl -i 'https://eu1-api.redwood/models/v1/complete?prompt=embed-test' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
Headers indicate delayed kvcache population (~200ms) on first token.
Kevin (Runtime): That pattern looks like kernel-selection fallback — canary machines hit a fallback path into an FF quantized route for small batch sizes. Might explain p95 spike.
Observability Bot: metric summary for window 1712347800-1712348200: embed.synth.p95=980ms, prefix.cache.hit=72% (-8pp), error.rate=0.4% (+0.25pp).
Maria: Decision proposal: pause rollout & pin eu1 to model:v1.12.2 until we confirm kernel path fix. Alan, can you trigger a pin? Jen, please add a quick perf regression test to the smoke suite.
Alan (SRE): On it. Running: 
```
deployctl pin --region eu1 --service inference --version v1.12.2 --reason "synth p95 regress" --requested-by maria
```
Will report back when switchover completes.
Deploy Bot: Action queued: pin to v1.12.2 in eu1. Expected switchover ~45s.
Deploy Bot: Pin complete. eu1 now serving v1.12.2. Rolling back canary traffic. :white_check_mark:
Kevin (Runtime): I'll open infra ticket to prevent quant-fallback on this model family for typical seq lengths and add a canary kernel check in CI.
Jen (QA): Created ticket RD-4021 "embed synth latency regression" with repro steps, curl logs, and synthetic job output. Added @customer-success to notify impacted accounts.
Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release notes and changelog: https://confluence.redwood/releases/v1.12.3-changelog and schedule a follow-up canary after the kernel fix.
Alan (SRE): Recommend re-running full smoke (gatekeeper-scanline + kv warmup) after runtime fix, and use a smaller warmup ramp (0.2) for next canary. Leaving rollout paused for now. :thumbsup:
